authors: MarketAlly Pte Ltd, David H. Friedel Jr.
description: Runs Syncfusion .NET MAUI controls on Linux. Syncfusion's platform-neutral build, which Linux apps get, has no native drawing, touch or invalidation; this package supplies them on OpenMaui's Skia renderer. Call .UseLinuxSyncfusion() in place of .ConfigureSyncfusionCore(). SfView-based controls (ListView, TreeView, TabView, effects and the rest) lay out, draw and receive touch, tap, double-tap, right-tap and long-press; SfDataGrid, SfScheduler, SfPullToRefresh and SfToolbar take the mouse and keyboard as on Windows, and SfImageEditor edits and saves images. Requires your own Syncfusion license; this package does not include or redistribute Syncfusion assemblies.
releaseNotes:
OpenMaui 10.0.110.8:
- Linux handlers implement MAUI's handler interfaces
- ILayoutHandler operations
- IImageHandler.SourceLoader and IButtonHandler.ImageSourceLoader load images
- MAUI-signature static Map methods
- Public platform extensions for the Skia views
- Names that do not clash with MAUI's
- Pointer events say which device sent them
- Touchscreens on Wayland
- Touchscreens on X11
- Application.ActivateWindow brings a window to the front
- Startup notification
- Shell.SearchHandler
- HybridWebView `WebResourceRequested` for http and https requests
- Contacts on KDE
- The Shell's bottom tab bar is replaced by the top navigation pane
- OpenMaui's types whose names clash with MAUI's
- Concrete-handler `Map*` overloads
- Handlers an app or library registers are used
- `UseLinux()` no longer replaces a handler the app registered before it
- Shell tabs are a Windows-style top navigation pane
- The Shell flyout lists MAUI's flyout items
- A Shell whose root is a TabBar has no flyout
- Flyout header Scroll and CollapseOnScroll behaviours
- A touch reorder drag waited for nothing
- CarouselView ignored `IsBounceEnabled` and its snap points
- CarouselView used the left `PeekAreaInsets` on both sides
- A looping carousel of two items with a peek showed one neighbour
- ListView went back to the top on every change of its items
- Window.TitleBar extends into the title bar on X11 and on KDE/Sway Wayland too
- Client-side decorations: double-click and window menu
- SecureStorage talks to the Secret Service over D-Bus
- Application.Quit() closes the app
- `SkiaFlexLayout` aligned a child with `AlignSelf` Start as Center, Center as End and End as Stretch
- The Linux `MenuBarHandler` never filled its `SkiaMenuBar`
- A click on a dimmed popup's backdrop was not a background click
- Tab moved focus to the page beneath an open popup
- MediaElement `UriMediaSource.HttpHeaders` reach HLS and DASH segment requests
- vCard parsing

Full changelog: https://github.com/open-maui/maui-linux/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
